cross_epoch_test.question: Which manipulation mechanisms persist across poster, print, radio, television, web/social and generative-AI eras after channel-specific affordances are removed?
cross_epoch_test.anti_overreach: A recurring mechanism is a communication regularity candidate, not evidence that all historical actors, goals or moral contexts are equivalent.
